title: Proof by Deduction
page_title: Proof by Deduction | Edexcel International A Level (IAL) Maths Revision Notes 2020

blocks.md: Proof by deduction is when a mathematical and logical argument is used to show whether or not a result is true

blocks.text: How do I use proof by deduction?

blocks.alt: Proof by Deduction Notes Diagram 1, Edexcel A Level Maths: Pure revision notes

blocks.md:
- Write multiples of **n **in the form **kn** for some integer **k**
- Use algebraic techniques, showing logical steps of simplifying
- Use correct mathematical notation

- ℕ - the set of *natural numbers*
- ℤ - the set of *integers*
- ℚ - the set of *quotients*/rational numbers
- ℝ - the set of *real numbers*

blocks.alt: Proof by Deduction Notes Diagram 2, Edexcel A Level Maths: Pure revision notes

blocks.label: Exam Hint
blocks.md:
- Try the result you are proving with a few values

  - Use a sequence of them (eg 1, 2, 3)
  - Try different types of numbers (positive, negative, zero)
- This may help you see a pattern and spot what is going on
